name: ABSL_Function_Business_agent
business: Ready Mix Concrete (RMC) - Akij Readymix Concrete Ltd (ARMCL)
scope: Function-based view of the Sales & Marketing business: business functions, sub-functions, activities, rules, KPIs, and data sources
source: Google Sheet 'all file ABSL' > tab 'Sales & Marketing' (gid=13336618); SOP ARMCL-SLS-001 (SALES DEPARTMENT-SOP-ARMCL-190625.pdf); DWH database (business unit 175)

functions.purpose: Set annual business plan, sales strategy, monthly targets and KPIs by role and region
activities: Annual Business Plan preparation and budget alignment
Sales Strategy development (market, segment, pricing approach)
Monthly sales and collection target setting by designation and region
KPI definition and tracking
5-year strategy plan (02_5_Years_Plan.docx) and annual budget (01_Budget_2026-27.xlsx)
functions.owner: Head of Sales, Manager Planning & Business, CEO
rules: 100% sales target is mandatory baseline
Collection target minimum qualifying level: 90%

functions.purpose: Identify target markets and generate qualified leads for the sales pipeline
activities: Market research reports (competitor, segment, demand)
Lead generation via field visits, digital campaigns, references, construction sites
Inter-departmental referral program (Akij Resource employees)
Log leads in New Customer Search Format and share with research for profiling
functions.owner: Marketing Team, Sales Team, Research Department
rules: Referral leads must be submitted via standard form/portal; verbal referrals not accepted
First employee to submit a valid lead is eligible; validation within 48 working hours
Referrals leading to fully paid orders only; excludes Sales/BD/Pricing staff and temp/contract/intern
data_sources: GAP G7: market research unstructured - not in DWH

functions.purpose: Onboard new cash and credit customers through a gated, documented process
activities: Lead engagement: site visit, project details, volume forecast
Creditworthiness evaluation for credit customers (KYC, financials, site verification)
Negotiation of terms (credit amount/days, pricing, delivery)
Documentation and customer code creation in IBOS/CRM
Product delivery initiation
functions.owner: Sales Team, Credit Control, Compliance/Legal, CRM/IBOS Admin
rules: No credit customer activated without documented approval and bank guarantee/security
No sale without: application form, verified bank guarantee (if applicable), signed agreement, approved customer code in IBOS/CRM
KYC documents: trade license, TIN, bank statement, solvency certificate, NID, references
Customer records digitized and retained for at least 3 years

functions.purpose: Approve product pricing, discounts, credit days, and credit limits within delegated authority
activities: Price quotation from approved pricing matrix (by grade, distance, volume)
Discount justification and approval
Credit days and credit limit determination
Final approval communication and ERP system setup with alerts
functions.owner: Sales Executive, Team Leader, Head of Sales, Finance & Accounts, SBU Head/CEO
rules: No discount given verbally or informally - all documented and approved
Overdue beyond 60 days triggers automatic credit hold
Credit limits reviewed every 3 months
Standard and customer-specific prices are confidential
data_sources: GAP G2: policies not in DWH

functions.purpose: Execute order booking, production planning, delivery scheduling, invoicing, and collection through IBOS
activities: Order booking in IBOS (Order ID generation)
Delivery scheduling: batching time slots, TM/pump allocation, route optimization
Production execution: batching per grade, QC checks (slump, cubes)
Delivery: dispatch, in-transit tracking, site confirmation, Delivered status
Invoicing and collection follow-up
functions.owner: Sales Team, Distribution Officer, Production In-Charge, QC, Dispatch/Logistics, Finance
rules: All orders booked in IBOS; verbal/manual orders invalid
Same-day delivery cutoff: at least 3 hours before batching
Only confirmed, IBOS-approved orders can be batched
No unauthorized edits/deletions/offline entries; changes timestamped
Exceptions require Plant Manager or Sales Head approval and logged as 'exception entry'
data_sources: GAP G3: no iBOS live connector

functions.purpose: Drive customer satisfaction, complaint resolution, repeat sales, and long-term relationships
activities: Post-delivery follow-up call within 24 hours
Complaint logging, classification, assignment, and resolution
Service recovery and compensation
Key Account Management for strategic customers
Dormant customer re-engagement (inactive >90 days)
functions.owner: Sales Executive, Customer Service/CRM, QA/QC, Logistics, Sales Head/KAM
rules: Acknowledge complaints within 1 hour
Resolution TAT: Class A quality 48-72h, Class B delivery/pump 24h, Class C billing 48h, Class D behavior 72h
Escalate to Sales Head if TAT missed; to CEO if unresolved after 3 days
Compensation (replacement, pump refund, credit note, gift) requires Sales Head/CEO approval
Top 20% customers by revenue = Strategic Accounts; quarterly business reviews
data_sources: GAP G6: meeting minutes not stored

functions.purpose: Recover outstanding receivables and manage bad debt adjustment/write-off with governance
activities: Tiered collection follow-up by aging
Dispute categorization (technical, logistics, behavioral, administrative, situational, financial)
Ledger adjustment and credit note posting
Bad debt provisioning and write-off
Legal recovery for bankrupt/unwilling customers
functions.owner: Sales Team, Accounts & Finance, Audit, QC, Legal & Recovery Cell
rules: Follow-up ladder: 0-30d Sales -> 31-60d Accounts -> 61d+ Recovery Cell (MIS flagged)
Sales incentives held or reversed for amounts pending beyond 60 days
Adjustments only post-dispute-resolution, documented, approved by Head of Sales + Head of Accounts, validated by Internal Audit
Write-off sign-off: CFO + Audit + CEO (if above threshold)
TDS/AIT delay: 3 reminders; ledger adjusted after 90 days with tax implications noted
data_sources: GAP G4: incentives not in DWH

functions.purpose: Motivate sales performance and inter-departmental/external referrals through structured incentives
activities: Monthly sales target achievement incentive
Inter-departmental referral incentive program
External referral incentives (engineers, consultants, procurement)
Incentive validation, disbursement, and audit
functions.owner: Sales Head, HR, Finance, Audit & Compliance

sales_achievement: Mandatory 100% sales target; minimum qualifying collection 90%
Monthly slab by designation (100% / 90-99%): AGM-GM 14,000/12,000 | Mgr-Sr.Mgr 13,000/12,000 | Dy.Mgr 12,000/9,000 | Asst.Mgr 11,000/8,500 | Officer 8,000/6,000
Bonus: +2,000 if collection >110%; 10,000 quarterly consistency; 5,000 monthly best performer per region
Disqualified if dues unresolved >60 days or documentation incomplete
inner_referral: No prorated/partial payouts; paid only after full delivery + full payment; TDS deducted
external_referral: All incentives pre-approved by Sales Head and documented
Post-paid: per CFT (BDT 1-4) or fixed lump sum after full payment
Pre-paid: written justification + customer details before disbursement
Non-cash gifts: against budget, store challan + recipient signature/photo
Records retained >=3 years; monthly report to CEO/CFO; annual audit

functions.purpose: Monitor performance, maintain governance trail, and enable management decisions
activities: Weekly sales meetings and minutes
Sales reports via iBOS (customer statement, aging)
Weekly aging review
Monthly/quarterly pricing review
Monthly incentive and bad debt reporting to CEO/CFO
Internal audit and compliance
functions.owner: Sales Head, Finance, Internal Audit, Management Committee
rules: Weekly aging report tracking; further supplies held if dues exceed credit terms
Monthly bad debt review to Sales Head and CFO
Quarterly write-off committee for unresolved cases over 90 days
Yearly audit of all incentive payments and gift disbursements
